quotes.text: But poverty’s scourge is fiercest below $1.25 (the average of the 15 poorest countries’ own poverty lines, measured in 2005 dollars and adjusted for differences in purchasing power): people below that level live lives that are poor, nasty, brutish and short.
quotes.reference: 2013 June 1, “Towards the end of poverty”, in The Economist, volume 407, number 8838, page 11:
